meta.name: boss-zhipin-scraper
meta.description: Scrape BOSS直聘 (job listing site) via Chrome CDP. Searches jobs by keyword/city/filters, fetches JD details, outputs structured JSON/CSV with plaintext salary, and can summarize scraped results into a job-market prompt. Use when user wants to search/analyze jobs on BOSS直聘 or zhipin.com.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按关键词和城市抓取招聘职位,导出结构化表格并总结就业市场行情
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想批量收集招聘信息,用来求职对比或分析某地某岗位的市场行情
copy.tagline_en: Scrape job posts by keyword and city, export tables, and summarize the market
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to gather job listings in bulk for a job search or market analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Chrome CDP 连接浏览器，按关键词、城市和筛选条件在 BOSS直聘搜索职位、抓取 JD 详情，输出含明文薪资的结构化 JSON/CSV，并能把抓取结果汇总成求职市场提示词。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索或分析 BOSS直聘 / zhipin.com 上的职位时触发，比如按关键词、城市、薪资等筛选条件找工作。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude connects to Chrome over CDP to search BOSS直聘 jobs by keyword, city and filters, fetch JD details, and write structured JSON/CSV with plaintext salary, plus a job-market summary prompt from the scraped results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search or analyze jobs on BOSS直聘 / zhipin.com, for example by keyword, city or filter criteria.

say_en.text: Scrape AI Agent jobs in Shanghai, 3 pages, as CSV
